vat.note: Set enabled to 1 and a default rate to apply VAT to new invoices. Existing invoices keep their own stored rate.

currencySettings.note: Documents may be raised in any currency in the Currencies master. The rate is copied onto the document when it is raised, so a later rate change cannot restate a past sale.

messaging.note: API keys belong in the environment, not here. SMS_API_KEY and WHATSAPP_TOKEN.

smtp.note: The SMTP password is never stored here. Put it in the SMTP_PASSWORD environment variable — this file is committed to git.
